sources.project_disposition: Retain as methodological foundation for LLM measurement; separate extraction validation from identification and effect validation.
sources.limits: A review of text-based adjustment, not proof that modern embeddings remove confounding. Publisher acquisition rejected by collector host policy; author preprint inspected instead. No causal formula in the review was adopted without independent derivation.
